scenario: A previously healthy 46-year-old female is transferred for CT-confirmed subarachnoid hemorrhage with hydrocephalus and declining GCS while awaiting neurosurgical intervention. The ICU team must manage airway deterioration, hypotension, hypoxemia, and blood pressure goals while coordinating with Neurosurgery.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: She's GCS 5, she can't protect her airway. Let's prep for RSI intubation. Start bagging her with the BVM to pre-oxygenate, and get the RSI meds and airway kit ready now.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: RSI meds drawn up and ready. Patient's been pre-oxygenated with BVM. Ready for you when you are.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Pushing RSI meds now and intubating. Once the tube's in, confirm placement and get the ventilator set up.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: Intubation complete after BVM and RSI. Tube's in — I'll get the post-intubation checks going.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Tube's in and she's stable on the vent. Let's get her to CT head now to look for a cause of her decreased consciousness.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Let's get a 12-lead ECG now — the monitor's showing deep precordial T-wave inversions I want characterized properly.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Send a basic metabolic panel too — I want to rule out electrolyte and metabolic causes for her drop in consciousness.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: CT head's back — extensive subarachnoid hemorrhage centered at the craniocervical junction and basal cisterns, early intraventricular extension with moderate hydrocephalus. ECG shows sinus rhythm at 110 with 3mm diffuse ST elevation, now deep precordial T-wave inversions. BP 140/90, HR 98, sat 98% on the vent. BMP is pending, ready in a couple turns.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Start hypertonic saline now — the CT shows extensive SAH with intraventricular extension and hydrocephalus, so we're treating raised ICP. Keep her sedated and head of bed up at 30 degrees.

messages.speaker: nurse
messages.content: Hypertonic saline is up and running.

messages.content: BMP's back: Na 142, K 3.6, Cl 103, Cr 44, glucose 7, Ca 2.17, Mg 0.94, PO4 1.43, albumin 37. No metabolic cause on the panel. Head of bed's up at 30, sedation continuing.

messages.speaker: clinician
messages.content: Start levetiracetam for seizure prophylaxis — she's got extensive SAH with intraventricular extension, so she's high risk. Keep her sedated and head of bed at 30.
